issues.title: V4.1 Flash rewrites the price list, and Harness changes its session format
issues.title_zh: V4.1 Flash 改写价目表，Harness 换了会话格式
issues.excerpt: DeepSeek ships V4.1 Flash, cuts Flash prices by up to 60% and starts retiring V4 Pro, while DeepSeek Harness lands four releases in four days — including session format V3 and V4.1 Flash as the default model for new sessions.
issues.excerpt_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4.1 Flash，同日把 Flash 价格下调最高 60%，并开始让 V4 Pro 退场；DeepSeek Harness 四天发出四个版本，包括会话格式 V3，以及把 V4.1 Flash 设为新会话默认模型。

issues.title: GPT-6 Astra lands, and Harness rebuilds its foundations
issues.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra 来了，Harness 也把地基重打了一遍
issues.excerpt: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Astra and declares the AGI era, while DeepSeek Harness rolls out v0.1.2-rc.1 and v0.1.3-alpha.1 with a v2 session format, a new SessionHandle API, and the SQLite backend removed.
issues.excerpt_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra 并宣告 AGI 时代，DeepSeek Harness 则发布 v0.1.2-rc.1 与 v0.1.3-alpha.1——会话格式升级 v2、新 SessionHandle API、SQLite 后端移除。

issues.title: DeepSeek gets honest about security
issues.excerpt: DeepSeek's safety note admits Harness isn't security-audited, while the v0.1.2-alpha line ships subagent model selection, exact token usage, and a Windows Python SDK.
issues.excerpt_zh: DeepSeek 在安全说明中承认 Harness 尚未接受安全审计，同时 v0.1.2-alpha 系列带来子代理模型选择、精确 token 统计与 Windows 版 Python SDK。

issues.title: Harness hits its first security scare — RCE at CVSS 9.8
issues.title_zh: Harness 迎来第一次安全危机——极危 RCE 漏洞 CVSS 9.8
issues.excerpt: A critical unauthenticated RCE (CVSS 9.8) rocks DeepSeek Harness, alongside rc.8 multimodal, the Claude Code/Codex scheduling layer, and weekend off-peak pricing.
issues.excerpt_zh: 极危未授权远程代码执行漏洞（CVSS 9.8）冲击 DeepSeek Harness，同时还有 rc.8 多模态、Claude Code/Codex 调度层与周末低谷定价。

issues.title: DeepSeek Harness goes open source — and V4 pricing goes time-of-day
issues.title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 开源了，V4 定价也改成了错峰计价
issues.excerpt: This week DeepSeek did two things: open-sourced its Harness agent runtime and switched V4 API billing to peak/off-peak tiers. Here's our read on both — what changed, what to read, and what it means for anyone building on DSH.
issues.excerpt_zh: 这一周 DeepSeek 做了两件事：把 Harness agent 运行时开源，以及把 V4 API 改成错峰计价。本期是我们的解读——发生了什么、值得读什么，以及对每个在 DSH 上开发的人意味着什么。
